items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But they were the class act. They taught me more about music than anybody else, being available at Florentine Gardens.

ctx.x: Yeah. I came to California. Ted FioRito was in a place called the Florentine Gardens. The Mills Brothers were the main attraction there. You talk about learning something. Harry, [?] – all four of them, actually. Their father was still living. But they were the class act. They taught me more about music than anybody else, being available at Florentine Gardens. It was three months there at Florentine Gardens. While I was there, they had a pickpocket, a guy by the name of Dr. Giovanni. He had somebody come up, and…
An amazing story. Did he even talk to you? Did he ever say anything to you?
